next.name: GOLD ANDREW
next.headline: GOLD ANDREW (Smoky Spider): the actor catalogued with Smoke Loader
next.in_short: Secureworks tracks GOLD ANDREW, also called Smoky Spider, and the catalogue lists Smoke Loader as its tool. Public reporting on that malware points to criminal use, with Ukraine and Taiwan among the places named.

sentences.t: GOLD ANDREW is the name used in the Secureworks catalogue entry for this actor.
The same entry gives one alias, Smoky Spider.
The catalogue lists one tool for the actor: Smoke Loader.
The cards hold no victim list for GOLD ANDREW itself. They cover the Smoke Loader malware, so these points describe that malware, not proven actions of this actor.
The Malpedia page for SmokeLoader indexes reports on attacks against Ukrainian institutions, including the auto and banking industries, and a report on an attack on companies in Taiwan.
Malpedia describes SmokeLoader as a generic backdoor. Its abilities depend on the modules built into each version.
According to Malpedia, the malware is delivered in several ways and is broadly associated with criminal activity.
Report titles on the Malpedia page mention HTML application files, malvertising and a ZIP concatenation trick as ways to spread or hide the malware.
Other listed titles describe extra obfuscation, anti-hooking and packing meant to hinder analysis.
Listed report titles also name malware that SmokeLoader was seen dropping or paired with: Xehook Stealer, zgRAT, Amadey and Vidar. Cobalt Strike appears in another listed title.
The Malpedia page lists a Trend Micro report, dated 4 February 2025, on a zero-day campaign against Ukrainian organizations that used CVE-2025-0411.
It also lists a Europol Operation Endgame follow-up, dated 9 April 2025, with five detentions and server takedowns.
The page is an index of third-party reports, so it does not on its own tie each item to GOLD ANDREW.
Keep software patched and treat unexpected attachments and ads with caution.
A loader infection can be the first step before other malware arrives, so investigate it fully.
